name: lookup: no url lookup of the anchors
why: An event MusicBrainz links to the row's own Brucebase anchor is the row's, found with one request per 100 entries (probe 2026-10-24).

name: lookup: the name search's top hit on any date
why: A name-search hit counts only on the row's own date; the top hit of "1985-01-10: …" may be another show at that venue.

name: lookup: the store is never read
why: A second visit answers every row from the store (90 days, 7 for no event) with no request.

name: lookup: a failure stored as no event
why: A request that failed leaves its rows unanswered, shown as failed and asked again on a click; it is never stored.

name: lookup: the setting ignored
why: sa_bb_mb_event_lookup off: nothing is asked until the ▶ MB header button.

name: late write: the filter caches kept
why: docs/claude/filter-and-cache-invariants.md: a post-render cell write invalidates the filter result cache and re-runs an active filter.
grep: late answers reach an active filter
